# Best MagSafe/Qi2 car mounts (as of Oct 2026)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three of the roundups pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical slats can sag under the weight.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest charging and best cooling: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (A2933), $89.99 list, listed at $69.99 in one roundup**
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, and Mount Guys uses it as their own daily driver.
- It works best with a 45W+ USB-C adapter. Gadgeteer and Mount Guys say a 60W adapter is in the box, but confirm that on the listing.
- It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars without standard vent blades.
- Only the iPhone 16 and 17 series get 25W, and older iPhones top out around 15W, so it's only worth the money for a newer phone.
- Sources: [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost**
- The fan helps prevent heat throttling on sunny dashboards. It mounts on a vent or the dash.
- Prices vary by source. The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99 (no car adapter included, so budget another $10–15). Dealectric lists the ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost at $39.99, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25).
- [Buy from ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is a commission link, and the price is the same for you.

**Budget 25W with a bundled adapter: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, $39.95**
- It ships with a 95W adapter. Keep the fan on for the full 25W, since fan-off mode caps at 15W. See [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).

**If you don't need charging: VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount**
- It has a metal-core vent clip, which holds up better than plastic hinges. Mount Guys chose it from research, not hands-on testing. See [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/).

**Tips**
- Look for a real Qi2 badge. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- Ignore "80 lb suction" claims, which describe the dash base, not the phone grip.
- If your vents are poor, choose a dash or windshield version, such as Belkin's vent/dash model.

I couldn't get direct purchase URLs for the Belkin, Anker, or LISEN products from these results. The articles above link to the Amazon listings, so check the current price there.
